# EXCALIBUR Control Center v0.5.5

Packaging and distribution release. A native Linux **read-only hardware telemetry
control center** for CASPER EXCALIBUR G870 laptops. No new application
capabilities; still strictly read-only telemetry (no fan/RGB/power control).

## Assets

- **`excalibur-control-center-0.5.5-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`** — Arch/CachyOS package
  (GUI + integrated `excalibur-wmi` DKMS driver).
- **`excalibur-control-center_0.5.5-1~deb13_amd64.deb`** and
  **`excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.5-1~deb13_all.deb`** — Debian 13 (trixie);
  built against Qt 6.8.
- **`excalibur-control-center_0.5.5-1~ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb`** and
  **`excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.5-1~ubuntu24.04_all.deb`** — Ubuntu 24.04
  LTS; built against Qt 6.4. The two `.deb` sets are **not interchangeable**.
- **`EXCALIBUR_Control_Center-x86_64.AppImage`** — the Qt6 GUI only, built on
  Debian 12 (glibc >= 2.35). Bundles Qt6; **does not** install the DKMS driver,
  needs no root and never touches the system.
- **`excalibur-control-center-0.5.5.tar.gz`** — source archive.
- **`SHA256SUMS`** — checksums for all of the above.

All packages and the AppImage are produced and tested by the release CI. The
`.deb` packages are additionally installed, launched (offscreen) and removed in
isolated Debian 13 / Ubuntu 24.04 containers, which proves dependency closure.

## Changed

- **Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 `.deb` distribution** (new, published).
- **Release CI** now builds+tests the Debian and Ubuntu packages; the `release`
  job requires the AppImage and both `.deb` jobs before publishing.

## Fixed

- Debian/Ubuntu DKMS `postinst`/`prerm` no longer hard-code the module version
  (which previously made them silently no-op for every release other than the one
  they were written for).
- The RPM source-tarball version is derived from the spec instead of being
  hard-coded.
- Dev settings hooks: combined `--set-*` flags in one invocation now all apply.

## Install

```bash
# Debian 13
sudo apt install ./excalibur-control-center_0.5.5-1~deb13_amd64.deb \
                 ./excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.5-1~deb13_all.deb

# Ubuntu 24.04
sudo apt install ./excalibur-control-center_0.5.5-1~ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb \
                 ./excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.5-1~ubuntu24.04_all.deb

# Arch/CachyOS
sudo pacman -U excalibur-control-center-0.5.5-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst

# AppImage (GUI only; install the DKMS driver separately for telemetry)
chmod +x EXCALIBUR_Control_Center-x86_64.AppImage && ./EXCALIBUR_Control_Center-x86_64.AppImage
```

## Known limitations (honest status)

- **Fedora:** an RPM recipe exists but is **not published/supported** — its
  install/launch lifecycle was only exercised in a container, never in a verified
  Fedora VM (VirtualBox's unattended install is not compatible with the Fedora
  Workstation Live ISO).
- **AppImage Wayland:** verified under an isolated headless compositor (now PASS
  with the bundled shell/graphics integration). A real KDE/Wayland desktop run of
  the *AppImage* was not performed; the native packages were tested on a real
  KDE/Wayland session.
- **AppImage glibc floor:** built on Debian 12 → requires **glibc >= 2.35**
  (`GLIBCXX_3.4.30`); runs on Debian 12+/Ubuntu 22.04+.
- **Real hardware / kernel API:** live CASPER telemetry is verified on the
  maintainer's real EXCALIBUR G870 with a 7.2.x kernel. CI and containers have no
  WMI/EC hardware. The driver does **not** build against **6.18.x-lts**
  (`BUILD_EXCLUSIVE_KERNEL_MIN="7.2"`), and the module builds only where the
  `wmidev_set_block` / `wmidev_query_block` API exists.
- **Debian/Ubuntu real desktops:** install/launch/remove are verified in isolated
  containers; the complete GUI/telemetry path is verified on the real Arch host,
  not inside a Debian/Ubuntu VM.
- **Secure Boot:** the packages neither generate keys nor sign modules; module
  signing is the user's responsibility.
